card.name: Rate and interval words in dosing
card.fires_on: Words that complete a rate or interval after a number or amount, such as every, per, a week, hours apart, or the unit in a step increment. Seen mostly in dose schedules, also in price or quantity rates.

modes.label: Per-time rate
modes.description: Every, per or a before a time unit that finishes a rate.
modes.example: adding about 1,100 beef cattle to feedlots<< every>> day for five years.

modes.label: Units inside dose steps
modes.description: A unit or range word after a number in weight bands or dose increments.

modes.label: Cycle or interval wording
modes.description: Hours or punctuation in a repeating schedule description.
modes.example: taken approximately 12<< hours>> apart with or without a meal.
